_comment: Thresholds for the risk and alerts commands. Tune freely. Percentages are whole numbers (5 = 5%).

notifications._comment: Send triggered alerts to WhatsApp. Secrets (API key / tokens) go in environment variables, NEVER here. provider: 'callmebot' (free personal) or 'twilio'. Set enabled=true once your env vars are in place. Set dry_run=true to preview the request without sending.
